newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea 3-yr yields end flat, call rates soar.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea 3-yr yields end flat, call rates soar.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporate bonds closed flat on Monday after a day of fluctuations as early bargain hunting was offset by late profit-taking, brokers said.
The overnight call rates soared due to rising tax and salary payments towards the end of the month.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.49 pct unchanged from Saturday
* Overnight call average 19.00 pct from 16.00 on Saturday
They said heavy new issues, estimated at 260 billion won, helped prompt profit taking. New issues would be about 64 billion won on Tuesday.
The overnight call rates soared to 19 percent from 16 percent on Saturday due to rising tax and salary payments towards the end of the month.
Brokers said the yields for the three-month CDs also rose because of drying liquidity in the shorter-term money market.
Liquidity was expected to tighten further ahead of the Korean Thanksgiving holidays in September, they said.
